'''Nex Pavros''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who led a group of hunters that were hired by [[Erron Irbian]] to attack the freighter ''[[Silver Star (G9 Rigger-class light freighter)|Silver Star]]'' and kill its crew.<ref name="CotG" />
